subject: TechSummit West 2025 — Sponsorship package discussion
messages:
From: Sophie Laurent <sophie@techsummit.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Aug 2025 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsorship Opportunity: TechSummit West 2025 — Platinum Package

Hi Marissa,

Hope you're well — excited to reach out about TechSummit West (Oct 14-16) in San Francisco. We still have a limited number of Platinum sponsorships available and thought Redwood would be a great fit for our platform/data-inference track.

Key highlights of the Platinum package (summary):
- 45-minute speaking slot on main stage (priority placement)
- Large logo on main stage backdrop + website + mobile app (prominent placement)
- 10x VIP expo passes; 3 booth staff + 1 lead retrieval feed
- Dedicated 1:1 customer matchmaking sessions and email blast to attendees (1x)
- Four (4) co-branded pre-show social posts and on-site signage

Attached is the full sponsorship pack with pricing and add-on options. Standard fee for Platinum: $75,000.

If you'd like, I can hold availability for 48 hours while you review. Happy to hop on a quick call to go through placement and speaking brief.

Best,
Sophie
Director, Strategic Partnerships
TechSummit

[Attachment: TechSummit_Sponsorship_Pack_v3.pdf (PDF, 320KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Laurent <sophie@techsummit.org>
Date: Sun, 10 Aug 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsorship Opportunity: TechSummit West 2025 — Platinum Package

Thanks Sophie — appreciate the quick outreach and the pack. A few quick asks from our side as we evaluate: 

- Can the 45-minute speaking slot be converted to a keynote or plenary (we prioritize keynote-level visibility)? If not, is there a Platinum+ option that guarantees keynote?
- We need explicit exclusivity for the "inference/serving/runtime" category (no competitor logos in the same session or on the same stage backdrop).
- Lead retrieval: can we receive raw leads within 24 hours post-event, and please confirm what fields are included (email, company, title, phone).
- Pricing: is there flexibility on the $75k figure for an enterprise partner commitment (we're evaluating a multi-event package across 2025-2026).
- Security/compliance: we'll need a SOC 2 Type II attestation and a data-handling clause restricting sharing PII with third parties.

Can you send any sample deliverable placement visuals (stage mockups) and the contract redline process (DocuSign link or similar)? If we can get keynote, exclusivity in category, and SOC2 evidence, I think we can move fast.

Thanks — I can jump on a call Mon morning if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

From: Sophie Laurent <sophie@techsummit.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsorship Opportunity: TechSummit West 2025 — Platinum Package

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear list. Quick responses inline: 

- Keynote: our Platinum standard includes a main-stage 45-minute session, typically a spotlight or panel. We can offer a "Platinum+ Keynote" add-on that guarantees a 30-minute keynote slot for an additional $10,000 (to cover program rework and promotion).
- Exclusivity: we can commit to "category exclusivity" for Platinum+ sponsors on main stage placements (we won't book a direct competitor in the same session/backdrop). I'll need competitor names to include in the clause.
- Lead retrieval: leads are available via CSV within 48 hours. Standard fields: first/last name, email, company, title, and opt-in status. Phone is provided only when attendees opt in. 
- Pricing: we can offer a multi-event credit of 10% if you commit to 2 events in 2025-2026 (applies on signature).
- SOC 2: we maintain event-platform SOC 2; I'll attach the attestation and can route a vendor data handling agreement.

Attaching updated proposal with a sample stage mock and an addendum for the keynote option. Here is a draft DocuSign link for contract routing as well.

Let me know if you want me to secure Platinum+ availability while you finalize internal approvals.

Best,
Sophie

[Attachment: TSW_Platform_Addendum_v1.docx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Sponsorship Opportunity: TechSummit West 2025 — Platinum Package

Avery — forwarding Sophie’s updated proposal. Key asks we should decide on quickly:

1) Do we take Platinum + Keynote add-on ($75k + $10k = $85k) or push for price concession to $60k with keynote included?
2) Exclusivity — they can do category exclusivity but will require competitor names listed. Suggest we ask for a clean exclusivity clause for "large-scale inference/runtime vendors" and include a right to first refusal for competing sponsors in our category at other events.
3) Lead data — require 24h delivery and include phone when available. Add a clause forbidding resale of lead data.
4) Security — need SOC 2 Type II attestation and a short DPA limiting retention to 30 days unless consented. Lauren, can you quick review whether 30 days is reasonable or if we should do 90? Also flag any redlines you'd require re: data/PII.
5) Marketing deliverables — insist on stage mockups in contract and a clause for logo placement priority (stage backdrop center vs. left).

Timeline: Sophie can hold for 48h but they're flexible if we ask for a short extension while legal reviews. If we get keynote + exclusivity + SOC2, this is basically a done deal from my side.

Marissa

[Forwarded attachments: TSW_Platform_Addendum_v1.docx, TechSummit_Sponsorship_Pack_v3.pdf]

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sponsorship Opportunity: TechSummit West 2025 — Platinum Package

Thanks Marissa — quick call notes and recommendation: 

- Recommendation: Accept Platinum with Keynote, but ask for a concession to $60k (net) given multi-event commitment potential and previous partner history. If they won’t go to $60k, take $65k and ask for the email blast + an additional dedicated promo slot.
- Exclusivity: support asking for category exclusivity. We should define competitors by name (I can provide a short list). Require a carveout for tech partners (non-competing integrations) only.
- Lead data: require delivery "within 24 hours" in CSV with the agreed fields; add prohibition on resale and a clause that Redwood retains sole right to use leads for marketing/sales.
- Security: Lauren — please confirm SOC 2 Type II receipt and advise on DPA retention term. My preference: 90-day retention is acceptable for lead sync, but marketing opt-outs must be honored immediately.
- Legal redlines: include cancellation/refund schedule (partial refund if cancelled >60 days), indemnity carveouts, and explicit statement that logo placement shown in the contract visuals is contractual and not "subject to change".

If legal is comfortable, I'll give Marissa go-ahead to send our counter and request DocuSign with the agreed addendum.

Avery
VP, Demand Generation
avery.johnson@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Laurent <sophie@techsummit.org>, TrueEvents Contracts <contracts@truevents.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Counter: TechSummit West 2025 — Redwood Platinum Sponsorship (summary & next steps)

Hi Sophie — thanks for the updated materials and for the DocuSign link. After internal review, Redwood's counter proposal is below (happy to have this turned into a contract addendum/DocuSign route):

Summary of counter-offer (Redwood):
- Sponsorship level: Platinum + Keynote (guaranteed 30-minute keynote on main stage).
- Net fee: $65,000 (Redwood offers a commitment to a second event in Q1 2026 for a 10% credit applied to that future event).
- Exclusivity: Category exclusivity for "large-scale inference/runtime" vendors on the main-stage session and stage backdrop for TechSummit West 2025. Redwood will provide a short list of competitors to exclude.
- Lead retrieval: Delivery of CSV within 24 hours post-event including fields: first/last name, email, company, title, phone (if opt-in), and opt-in status. Contract provision forbidding resale of leads and limiting Redwood’s use to marketing/sales outreach.
- Security/DPA: Prior to signature, TechSummit to provide SOC 2 Type II attestation and accept Redwood's DPA restricting retention of lead PII to 90 days unless explicit consent is provided by the attendee.
- Marketing deliverables: Contract to include stage mockups and guaranteed logo placement (center-right) on the stage backdrop and confirmation of 1x dedicated pre-show email blast.
- Cancellation: Partial refund schedule — 50% refund if TechSummit cancels >60 days out; full refund if event cancelled by organizer.

Please prepare a DocuSign-ready addendum reflecting the items above and route to contracts@redwood.ai and lauren.bishop@redwood.ai for legal review. We’d like a DocuSign draft within 48 hours so we can finalize.

HubSpot deal: HS-TS-2025-067
Drive MOP: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB2cDEFgHIjKlmnoPQrsT_uv/edit?usp=sharing

Thanks — looking forward to closing.

Best,
